xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes forming part of the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

1. The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of Belding India Limited (the "Company" or the "Holding Company") and its subsidiaries (the Company and its subsidiaries together referred to as "the Group") for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, is drawn in accordance with the Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of lndia (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), as amended, which have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 03, 2026 and were subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors of the company.

2. These Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results has been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 (“Ind AS 34”), Interim Financial Reporting prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with relevant rules issued thereunder, as amended, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in compliance with Regulation 33 of Listing Regulations, as amended.

3. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Holding Company acquired 100% of the equity share capital of Evolve IT Solutions Private Limited (“Evolve IT”) on July 23, 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The results of Evolve IT have been consolidated from the date of acquisition in accordance with Ind AS 103, Business Combinations, and its financial information has been prepared under Ind AS for the first time in accordance with Ind AS 101, First-time Adoption of Indian Accounting Standards. Accordingly, the consolidated results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 include Evolve IT, only for the period July 24, 2026 to September 30, 2026 and are not comparable with the corresponding prior periods. The company has complied with all applicable Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), except Ind AS 116 ‘Leases’, for which the management is assessing the applicability and the manner of adoption. The impact, if any, will be recognised upon completion of the assessment.

4. Nature of Discontinuance

During FY 2025–2026, the Company discontinued its operations relating to manufacturing of foils business. The criteria for classification as discontinued operations under Ind AS 105 – Non-Current Assets held for Sale and Discontinued Operations have been met.

The results of the discontinued operations have been presented separately in the Statement as profit/(loss) from discontinued operations. Comparative figures for the previous period have been re-presented to reflect discontinued operations distinctly from continuing operations.


5. Disclosure on Comparative Information

Comparative Figures
The Company had no subsidiaries during the corresponding period of the previous year. Accordingly, the comparative financial information presented in these Results has been drawn from the Standalone Financial Results of the Company for that period.

Basis of Presentation
Since, Consolidated Financial Results were not applicable during the corresponding period of the previous period, the current period’s consolidated results are not directly comparable with the prior period’s standalone figures.

6. Based on the management approach under Ind AS 108, the CODM evaluates the Group’s performance as a single segment. Accordingly, there is no reportable segment information in accordance with Ind AS 108 ‘Operating Segments’.

7. Business combination
DC&T Global Private Limited: With effect from 24 December 2025, the Company acquired 100% equity shares of DC&T Global Private Limited through a share swap, issuing 1,36,08,849 equity shares at Rs.769.16 per share, for a total consideration of Rs.1,04,673.00 lakhs. Net assets acquired were Rs.44,975.99 lakhs, resulting in goodwill of Rs.59,697.01 lakhs.
The purchase price allocation for this acquisition is provisional and will be finalised within the measurement period of one year from the acquisition dates, in accordance with Ind AS 103 -Business Combinations.

8. Previous period/year figures have been regrouped/ rearranged/ reclassified wherever considered necessary.
